title: Engage in legal practice only as an Australian legal practitioner
what: Engage in legal practice only as an Australian legal practitioner (a lawyer with a current practising certificate), or as the Act otherwise allows.

sources.title: Legal Profession Act 2006 (NT)
sources.quote: A person who is not an Australian legal practitioner must not engage in legal practice in this jurisdiction
